description: Government Office Western Province - The Province Rules Amended Western Province Council Public Severe No.1,2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains specifically to public service administration within the Western Provincial Council. It establishes amended procedural rules for annual transfers in the Western Provincial Council Public Service, including the composition of transfer committees, transfer eligibility criteria, and transfer procedures. The content focuses on public sector service conditions and administrative procedures, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) that cover "Public service recruitment and examinations," "Service conditions and benefits," and "Administrative circulars and instructions." While it mentions the Governor's name, this is in an official capacity to authorize the notification rather than constituting a personnel appointment or change that would fall under government personnel classifications.
